summary: Phases 1 and 3 completed. Created KampBypass.lean with enriched bypass formula definition (enriched_bypass_formula_depth1 for k=0, sorry for k+1) and wired all sorry chains through the single bypass theorem existPart_succ_n1_bypass. NfCharFormula, RabinovichNegation, and RabinovichGeneralized all now delegate to KampBypass at depth k+1. Phase 2 (correctness proof for the enriched formula) is the remaining core work. nf_exist_backward_prior is now dead code.

sorry_inventory.assumption: The enriched_bypass_formula_depth1 correctly characterizes the depth-1 2-var existential on Prior structures
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Correctness proof requires zone-precise temporal encoding of depth-0 3-var existentials (6+ zones, y-x-t order precision). Forward direction straightforward but backward direction needs Prior-UZ/SZ for zone discrimination. Estimated 200-400 lines.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Prove forward and backward directions of enriched_bypass_formula_depth1. Forward: given exists x with nf_eval, show enriched formula holds. Backward: from enriched formula truth, extract x and verify nf_eval. Key difficulty: backward direction for zones where y-t order differs from y-x order.

sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Research whether the enriched formula approach generalizes to all depths, or whether a different technique is needed for k >= 1.
